# Changelog

What was added or changed in OpenBGA Biorepository, newest first. Changes are
grouped by the calendar month they were merged in and ranked from high to low impact.
The same list is shown in the application under What's new.

## November 2026 (2026-11-13 to 2026-11-22)

### High impact

- **Changed:** A new look with section menus in the top bar (2026-11-18)

  The sidebar is replaced by a light top bar: each section (Specimens, Distribution, Storage, Equipment, Quality, Setup) opens a menu of its pages, and the repository name shows beside the product name. New type and colours run through the application in light and dark themes, with a new sign-in illustration and icon.

- **Changed:** Every form opens in a dialog over the page it belongs to (2026-11-18)

  Every form now opens in a dialog over the page you opened it from, including password and two-factor changes; a form opened by its address opens over its record or list. A new Password page shows whether a password is set. Leaving a form with unsaved changes asks in a pop-up.

- **Added:** Escalate a withdrawal to destruction while keeping its holds (2026-11-17, Consent records)

  Managers can escalate an active no-further-use withdrawal to destruction from its consent record. Consent stays withdrawn and its existing holds remain in place; the original instruction and escalation remain visible in history. Disposal still requires an ordinary request and a different person's approval.

  Technical notes:

  > Adds the additive migration `distribution.0003_withdrawal_escalation` with append-only history protection and a database guard that keeps older writers from bypassing escalation-specific reinstatement checks. Keep this migration applied during code rollback; older pages do not display escalation details and an unsafe reinstatement fails. Do not reverse the migration after history has been recorded. No dependency or environment changes.

- **Changed:** The application is now called OpenBGA Biorepository (2026-11-17, [#15](https://github.com/openbga/biorepository/pull/15))

  The product is now named OpenBGA Biorepository. The new name appears in the top bar, page titles, sign-in, error pages, footer and page help; on phones the top bar wraps the name onto two lines.

  Technical notes:

  > No migration and no change to records. The default `SOURCE_CODE_URL` now points to `https://github.com/openbga/biorepository`; a deployment that sets it should check it points to its published source. Hosting service, database and logger names are unchanged and need no action.

- **Added:** Keep staff training records with completion evidence (2026-11-15, Training records, [#12](https://github.com/openbga/biorepository/pull/12))

  Under Training records, managers assign a training topic with an optional procedure reference and due date, record completion with the trainer and evidence, and correct or cancel an assignment with a reason that stays in the history. Staff can search and filter assignments and renewal dates; a record grants no permissions.

  Technical notes:

  > Adds migration `quality.0003_training` (additive; protects event history and prevents deleting records). No dependency changes.

- **Added:** Record and review deviation reports (2026-11-15, Deviations, [#9](https://github.com/openbga/biorepository/pull/9))

  Under Deviations, staff report an issue, record the investigation, corrective action and effectiveness evidence, and submit it for review by a manager other than its creator and latest submitter, who closes or returns it. Every correction, return and reopening keeps the earlier values and reason, and optional links to an excursion or inventory audit change no specimen or hold.

  Technical notes:

  > Adds migration `quality.0002_deviations` (two tables with history guards; additive). The review sequence is a product default, not repository policy.

- **Added:** Audit a box against a saved inventory snapshot (2026-11-14, Inventory audits, [#3](https://github.com/openbga/biorepository/pull/3))

  Under Inventory audits, staff compare a box's physical contents with a frozen snapshot and record matches, missing specimens, unexpected identifiers and mismatches. Completing or cancelling an audit keeps an attributed record that cannot change, and an audit never moves specimens or changes their status or holds.

  Technical notes:

  > Adds migration `quality.0001_initial` (two tables protected against update and delete). An audit covers one box of up to 400 positions; a correction starts a new linked audit. Viewers can read audits.

- **Added:** First public release of OpenBGA Biorepository (2026-11-13)

  A free, open-source biorepository management system for one repository organization per deployment. Staff record storage from sites and freezers down to box positions, specimens and aliquots, custody, holds, disposal with a separate approval, labels, CSV import, equipment records with temperature excursions, and distribution from consent and requests through shipment, receipt and return.

  Technical notes:

  > Django and PostgreSQL with Bootstrap and HTMX, licensed AGPL-3.0-only. Run `migrate` before the first start; `seed_demo` loads synthetic demonstration records and must stay away from a real repository database. This software supports a repository's own records and does not certify compliance or accreditation.

### Medium impact

- **Changed:** Browse earlier changes to storage records (2026-11-20, Storage)

  Open History on a storage record to see the latest changes. Use Next page to see older changes while keeping your place in Moves on a box or rack record.

- **Changed:** Browse earlier box and rack moves (2026-11-19, Storage)

  The Moves table on a box, rack, shelf, tower or canister record now includes every move recorded directly for that container. When there are more than 20 moves, use Next page to see earlier moves and their recorded reasons.

- **Fixed:** Copy four-level storage layouts into a new unit (2026-11-19, Storage units)

  Save layout as template keeps all four rack and shelf levels, including top-level slots above 100. When existing codes would give a duplicate or invalid suffix, the form suggests a unique suffix you can edit before saving.

- **Fixed:** Print labels for every specimen in a committed import (2026-11-19, Imports)

  Open a committed import to print labels in file order. Imports with more than 200 specimens now have a preview and PDF for each range, including the final partial group.

- **Added:** A storage path bar shows where things are (2026-11-18)

  Storage records and the specimen record show a path bar under the top bar, from the site down to the box and position, with the storage unit's nominal temperature. While a specimen is checked out, the bar marks the position it left and shows how long it has been out of storage.

- **Fixed:** Dashboard counts open exactly the rows they count, with a specimen journey (2026-11-18)

  Requests awaiting my decision now opens exactly the requests it counts, and every dashboard count matches the rows its link opens. A specimen journey at the top of the dashboard shows where work is waiting, from receipt and storage through check-out to distribution or disposal.

- **Changed:** Distribution and quality pages show status and key facts first (2026-11-18)

  Distribution and quality records open with their status and labelled key facts, one main action with the rest under More, and their history in its own panels. Institutions, investigators and specimen types show their names before their codes.

- **Added:** Export the disposal request register (2026-11-18, Disposal requests)

  In Disposal requests, staff can download all matching requests in the selected order. The CSV includes each request’s current state, requester and decision maker.

- **Added:** Export the filtered deviation register (2026-11-18, Deviations)

  On Deviations, apply a search and status filter, then choose Export CSV to download the six register columns in the selected order. The file includes matching reports across all pages.

- **Added:** Export the inventory audit register (2026-11-18, Inventory audits)

  Staff can download the audits matching a search or status filter in the selected sort order.
  The CSV includes the frozen box code and full creation reason for every matching audit.

- **Added:** Export the specimen import register (2026-11-18, Imports)

  Use Export CSV on the Imports page to download the state, row and error counts, and validation details for each file matching your search. The download follows your selected sort order across all pages.

- **Added:** Export the temperature-reading import register (2026-11-18, Temperature readings)

  On the Imports tab of Temperature readings, select Export CSV to download the files matching your search and validation state. Each row shows who validated the file and when, the equipment, and the row and error counts.

- **Changed:** Find available positions from storage records (2026-11-18, Free positions)

  Select a positive Free count on a storage record to see available positions in that room, unit, rack, shelf or box. Select a position to open its cell in the box grid.

- **Changed:** Lists remember your columns, rows per page and sort on any workstation (2026-11-18)

  List column layouts, rows per page and sort are remembered for each user on the server, so they follow you to any workstation and the next person at a shared one starts from the defaults. On narrower screens, less important columns start hidden; Columns brings them back.

  Technical notes:

  > Migration `core` 0004 adds the table `core_userpreference` (additive).

- **Changed:** One date field, searchable menus and units beside numbers in every form (2026-11-18)

  Dates and date-times use one typed field with a calendar (weeks start on Sunday; Today, Yesterday, Now and Clear; labelled with the repository time zone). Choice lists are searchable menus, numbers show their unit beside the field (°C, kg) and keep exactly what you type, file fields accept drag and drop, and hints open as tooltips.

- **Changed:** Page help opens with a summary, common tasks and good-to-know notes (2026-11-18)

  Help on every page now starts with a short summary, the common tasks with the exact buttons to use, and a few things good to know. The full field reference is still there, collapsed behind a filter.

- **Changed:** The specimen record's header shows what matters first (2026-11-18)

  A specimen's header now shows its status (including an active hold), type, amount on hand, a running time-out-of-storage clock while it is checked out, and its thaw count. Print label and Request disposal moved into the More menu.

- **Added:** Export the training register to CSV (2026-11-17, Training records)

  On Training records, use Export CSV to download assignments and renewal dates across all matching pages. The file follows the filters and sort order you applied.

- **Fixed:** Identify temperature readings that had no recorded limits (2026-11-17, Temperature readings)

  Temperature readings now show “No limits recorded” when both bounds were blank. Use the Limits filter to find those readings or readings within the recorded bounds. The same assessment appears on equipment and excursion records and in the new Limit assessment CSV column.

- **Added:** See what changed in the application under What's new (2026-11-17)

  Select What's new in the top bar to read the changes to the application, newest first, grouped by month and ranked by impact. A number beside it counts the changes made since you last looked in this browser, and opening the list clears it; a first visit starts with no number.

  Technical notes:

  > Entries are files in `changelog.d/`; `uv run python manage.py changelog` generates `CHANGELOG.md` and `--check` fails when it is stale. What each account has seen is kept in the browser's local storage, so no migration is needed.

- **Added:** Load scanner CSV observations into an inventory audit (2026-11-14, Inventory audits, [#5](https://github.com/openbga/biorepository/pull/5))

  An open inventory audit can now load a box's observations from a scanner CSV file. The grid fills only after the whole file passes validation, and you review and edit it before completing the audit; a rejected file keeps what you had entered.

  Technical notes:

  > No migration. The file uses the project's normalized UTF-8 CSV format, one box at a time, with every position listed; a scanner's own export format needs converting first. The file itself is not stored.

- **Added:** Place holds on specimens affected by a temperature excursion (2026-11-14, Temperature excursions, [#7](https://github.com/openbga/biorepository/pull/7))

  From a temperature excursion, staff can select the affected specimens and place disposal, use or all-use holds with a reason, up to 200 at a time. Managers release these holds from the specimen record; closing or reopening the excursion leaves them in place.

  Technical notes:

  > No migration. The selection is rechecked when submitted and expires after one hour. No temperature triggers a hold automatically.

### Low impact

- **Fixed:** Correct the help for the dashboard, sign-in codes and authenticator setup (2026-11-22, Dashboard)

  The dashboard help now says which queues have no link at a count of 0 and when "Nothing is waiting for you" appears. The sign-in code help names the address line as it appears on the page, and the authenticator setup help no longer says the form has no Cancel button.

- **Fixed:** Keep your filters when a storage CSV exceeds the row limit (2026-11-20, Free positions)

  If more than 10,000 rows match when you select Export CSV, the storage list reopens with your filters and sort order. Narrow the selection there and try again.

- **Fixed:** See full locations in Racks and shelves and Free positions (2026-11-20, Racks and shelves)

  In Racks and shelves, the Location column shows the full path from the top of the unit to the location in each row. In Free positions, follow the path in the Rack or shelf column to open the location holding the box.

- **Fixed:** See the full rack or shelf path in Boxes (2026-11-20, Boxes)

  The Rack or shelf column shows the path from the top of the storage unit to the container holding the box. Sort by Container type to put grid versions in numeric order within each code, both in the register and in its CSV.

- **Fixed:** See when a distribution selection is too large to export (2026-11-20, Requests)

  Distribution lists and catalogues show the 10,000-row limit when too many records match. Narrow the selection or correct any filter errors to see Export CSV. A valid search with no matches still downloads the column headings.

- **Fixed:** See when a specimen selection is too large to export (2026-11-20, Specimens)

  The Specimens list and its catalogue tabs show the 10,000-row limit when too many records match. Narrow the selection or correct a filter to see Export CSV. A search with no matches can still download the column headings.

- **Fixed:** See when a storage selection is too large to export (2026-11-20, Free positions)

  Storage lists and catalogues show the 10,000-row limit when too many rows match. Narrow the selection or correct invalid filters to see Export CSV. A valid search with no matches still downloads the column headings.

- **Fixed:** Consistent limits on specimen and distribution CSV downloads (2026-11-19, Specimens and distribution)

  Specimen and distribution lists and catalogues check the 10,000-row limit when you download a CSV. If another staff member changes the matching records, you receive the full selection within the limit or a message to narrow your filters. The audit trail records the number of data rows in each file.

- **Fixed:** Find every unit in a storage class (2026-11-19, Storage catalogues)

  Select All units in this class on a storage class to search its active and retired units, including those beyond the 100 shown on the class record.

- **Changed:** Open free positions from storage lists (2026-11-19, Storage units)

  In Rooms, Storage units, Racks and shelves, or Boxes, select a positive Free count to see the available positions in that location. Select a position to open its cell in the box.

- **Fixed:** Retired boxes show every position as unavailable (2026-11-19, Boxes)

  Open a retired box to see its original position labels and any block reasons recorded at retirement. The grid marks all positions as unavailable.

- **Changed:** Account pages use sentence case and the standard controls (2026-11-18)

  Account pages use sentence case throughout (Email addresses, Make primary, Two-factor authentication, Change password). On the email page, Remove is an outlined destructive button at the start of the row, and address choices use the standard radio control.

- **Fixed:** Accurate row counts for storage CSV downloads (2026-11-18, Storage)

  CSV exports from storage lists and storage catalogues now check the 10,000-row limit and record the audit count from the rows in the download, even when another staff member changes the inventory during export.

- **Changed:** Ongoing excursions show a running clock and their extreme (2026-11-18)

  Ongoing temperature excursions show a running clock, and their extreme temperature beside the unit's nominal temperature.

- **Fixed:** Page help describes the specimen lookup and What's new link as they work (2026-11-18)

  The help for the top bar now says that Find specimen ID opens the specimen with that ID, or the specimen list with a warning when none matches, and that the field is hidden on very narrow screens. The What's new help says the link appears on signed-in pages.

- **Fixed:** Pick lists and manifests take the new look; draft manifests show their watermark (2026-11-18)

  Printed pick lists and shipment manifests take the new look in black and white. A manifest printed before dispatch now shows its "Not dispatched" watermark, which was hidden before.

- **Changed:** Sign-in shows Remember me and the password-reset link on one row (2026-11-18)

  On the sign-in page, Remember me and Forgot your password? share one row under the password.

- **Added:** Specimen records list their requests and consents; box maps mark holds (2026-11-18)

  A specimen's record lists the requests it was allocated to and its participant's consents, each with its status, for people who may read distribution. The box map marks specimens on hold and counts them.

- **Changed:** Status labels show an icon for their tone (2026-11-18)

  Every status label now carries an icon for its tone, so colour is never the only cue. A box with no blocked positions now shows 0 blocked instead of a blank.

- **Changed:** Storage, specimen and repository pages use the shared panels, lists and history (2026-11-18)

  Storage, specimen, announcement, record-retention and What's new pages use the shared panels, lists, notices and history; long histories start collapsed.

- **Added:** The dashboard shows the cold census of every storage unit (2026-11-18)

  The dashboard's path bar shows every storage unit with its nominal temperature, how full it is and any open excursion, as on the storage overview.

- **Added:** The full demonstration includes quality records (2026-11-18)

  The full demonstration (`seed_demo --full`) now includes inventory audits, deviations and training records in several states, so the quality pages show working examples.

- **Changed:** The storage overview flags open excursions and names sites and rooms (2026-11-18)

  The storage overview flags units with an open temperature excursion and names their sites and rooms. Box and import pages show catalogue names before codes.

- **Changed:** What's new groups changes as tiles by impact (2026-11-18)

  What's new uses the full width: changes are tiles grouped by impact, with high impact highlighted, the type as a coloured label, and the area and Go to link at the foot of each change. Labels such as statuses and counts never break across lines.

- **Fixed:** What's new links only to pages you can open (2026-11-18)

  What's new shows a Go to link only when your own menus offer that page, so a viewer no longer sees a link to Imports. An account without a role no longer sees section menus that lead nowhere.

- **Fixed:** Demonstration data no longer fails to load after a daylight-saving change (2026-11-15, [#10](https://github.com/openbga/biorepository/pull/10))

  Loading the full demonstration data near midnight after an autumn clock change could stop with an import error, because two temperature readings fell on the same local morning. Each demonstration reading now falls on its own local date.

  Technical notes:

  > Affects only `seed_demo` and the demonstration reset; no migration and no change to real records.
